record.question: The movie which bagged the largest number of Academy Awards in 2019 was
record.explanation: Answer C: Bohemian Rhapsody. At the 91st Academy Awards, Bohemian Rhapsody won four Oscars, more than the other listed 2019 films. Reference: https://www.oscars.org/oscars/ceremonies/2019. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
